jobs.name: daily-dotfiles-nixos-rebuild
jobs.prompt: No-agent daily NixOS maintenance: trigger hermes-daily-nixos-rebuild.service and stay silent on success. The script exits non-zero and prints diagnostics on failure.

jobs.name: sync-hermes-brain-to-github
jobs.prompt:
Sync Hermes persistent brain files to GitHub.

Use terminal commands only.
Source state: /home/hermes/.hermes
Mirror repo working copy: /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync
Remote: https://github.com/otto-hermes/hermes-brain.git

Policy:
- Prefer a gitignore-style mirror: copy the whole source tree, then exclude only secret/runtime/noisy paths.
- Do not handpick a short include list; safe new docs/reports should become visible in GitHub automatically.
- Never upload secrets or runtime data.

Do:
1) Ensure /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync exists and is a git repo cloned from the remote.
2) Ensure /home/hermes/.hermes/.gitignore exists and excludes at least: .env, config.yaml, auth.json, sessions/, logs/, cron/, platforms/, pastes/, local DB/cache files, *.key, *.pem, *.token, *.lock.
3) Sync source into mirror with rsync using delete mode, no owner/group/perms, protecting .git and excluding .gitignore patterns. Example shape:
   rsync -a --delete --no-owner --no-group --no-perms --filter='P .git/' --exclude='.git/' --exclude-from=/home/hermes/.hermes/.gitignore /home/hermes/.hermes/ /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync/
4) Remove ignored leftovers from the mirror without touching tracked safe files:
   HOME=/home/hermes git -C /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync clean -fdX
5) Commit only when there are changes (message: "chore: sync brain snapshot").
6) Push to origin main using HOME=/home/hermes so git sees Otto's stored GitHub HTTPS credentials.

If push fails, print concise diagnostics and exit non-zero.
If nothing changed, print "no changes".

jobs.name: sync-dotfiles-to-github
jobs.prompt:
Sync /home/hermes/dotfiles to GitHub repo otto-hermes/dotfiles.

Use terminal only.
Steps:
1) cd /home/hermes/dotfiles
2) Ensure origin is https://github.com/otto-hermes/dotfiles.git
3) git add -A
4) If there are staged changes, commit with message: "chore: automated dotfiles sync"
5) Push branch main to origin
6) If no changes, print "no changes"

On push failure, print concise diagnostics and exit non-zero.

jobs.name: no-agent-otto-health-watchdog
jobs.prompt: No-agent watchdog: run deterministic Otto health checks and deliver stdout verbatim only when the script reports actionable alerts. The script is intentionally quiet when healthy. Do not attach skills or model reasoning.

jobs.name: wiki-weekly-maintenance-lint
jobs.prompt: Weekly wiki maintenance: run wiki-lint.py to scan all .md files for broken wikilinks, stale frontmatter, missing tags, pages exceeding 100 lines, and orphan pages. Deliver findings to Telegram home channel. The script exits 0 when clean and 1 with a structured report when issues are found.

jobs.name: wiki-monthly-contradiction-scan
jobs.prompt: Monthly wiki contradiction and redundancy scan: run wiki-contradiction.py to detect overlapping topics, contradictory information, and redundant pages across the wiki. Deliver findings to Telegram home channel. The script exits 0 when clean and 1 with a structured report when overlaps/contradictions are detected.
